description: Funds an $8,500 mentorship program for Saskatoon artists.
Program supports emerging, mid-career, and newcomer artists.
It helps artists understand public art application processes.

chips.text: The $8,500 budget allocates funds for four mentors, eight mentees, and event costs.
The program prioritizes diverse representation and inclusion in mentor and mentee selection.
